# Fixtures the Gate 1 plan marks must_detect, one label per line:
#
#     <RULE> <fixture> [variant_of=<canonical-fixture>]
#
# JSON has no comment syntax, so the label lives here rather than inside the
# parsed content.
#
# A fixture that writes a must-detect scenario in an equivalent syntax is an
# independent must-detect fixture in its own right, because an analyzer that
# matches one spelling and misses the other detects nothing at all. It names the
# canonical fixture it varies so a reviewer reads the family rather than five
# unrelated cases.
PFR-DEP-001 pfr-dep-001-manifest-lock-mismatch.head.json
PFR-DEP-002 pfr-dep-002-git-dependency.json
PFR-DEP-002 pfr-dep-002-uppercase-git-dependency.json variant_of=pfr-dep-002-git-dependency.json
PFR-DEP-002 pfr-dep-002-url-dependency.json
PFR-DEP-002 pfr-dep-002-uppercase-url-dependency.json variant_of=pfr-dep-002-url-dependency.json
PFR-DEP-002 pfr-dep-002-path-escape.json
PFR-DEP-002 pfr-dep-002-uppercase-path-escape.json variant_of=pfr-dep-002-path-escape.json
PFR-DEP-004 pfr-dep-004-source-changed.head.json
